summary: Nine citation / filing-language findings: misapplied LPFM rules in Purpose & service vocab, swapped AM rule titles, misuse of §73.99 vs §73.187 in 301-AM, AM nighttime gap in regulatory-context classifier, and minor wording risks. Engineering math unaffected; red-pen filing-language fixes required before any LPFM/AM exhibit ships.

findings.title: Purpose section cites FM rules (§73.207/§73.215) for LPFM exhibits
findings.recommended_fix: Split the FM and LPFM branches in applicableRules(). LPFM must cite §73.807 (minimum-distance separations under Subpart G), §73.811 (power and antenna height), §73.313 (HAAT method) and §73.333 (FM curves applied to LPFM). The §73.215 contour-protection alternative is unavailable to LPFM and must not appear in an LPFM Purpose list.
tests_required: test/exports/engineeringReport/purpose.test.js — assert LPFM exhibit yields the §73.807/§73.811 list and never §73.215
findings.reproducibility_notes: genoa/src/exports/engineeringReport/sections/purpose.js lines 30-38 — the `if (svc === 'FM' || svc === 'LPFM')` branch returns the FM rule set verbatim. Run the Purpose builder against any LPFM station_inputs and confirm the §73.215 cite appears in the rendered list.

findings.title: AM applicable-rules list swaps §73.182 and §73.183 titles
findings.recommended_fix: Correct the AM list: §73.182 is 'Engineering standards of allocation', §73.183 is 'Groundwave signals' (reserved/cross-referenced to §73.184 graphs), §73.184 is 'Groundwave field strength graphs'. The Purpose list currently labels §73.182 as 'AM service contour standards' and §73.183 as 'Engineering standards of allocation' — both inaccurate per the current Code.
tests_required: test/exports/engineeringReport/purpose.test.js — snapshot the AM rule labels against canonical FCC titles
findings.reproducibility_notes: genoa/src/exports/engineeringReport/sections/purpose.js lines 48-54. Cross-check against current 47 CFR Part 73 Subpart A section titles (eCFR).

findings.title: Form 301-AM header miscites §73.99 as 'AM/FM mileage / co-channel separations'
findings.recommended_fix: 47 CFR §73.99 is 'Presunrise service authorization (PSRA) and Postsunset service authorization (PSSA)'. The AM co-channel / adjacent-channel separation rules live in §73.37. Fix the header REFERENCES block (lines 28-46) and remove §73.99 from the `frequency-khz` field cite — §73.99 is not the operating-frequency authority.
tests_required: test/exports/lmsFiling/form301am.test.js — assert no field cites §73.99 unless the field's lms_label references PSRA/PSSA
findings.reproducibility_notes: genoa/src/exports/lmsFiling/form301am.js line 29 (header REFERENCES block) and line 155 (`frequency-khz.cite`).

findings.title: Form 301-AM submission checklist mis-cites §73.187 for PSRA/PSSA tables
findings.recommended_fix: PSRA / PSSA pre-sunrise / post-sunset operation tables are authorized under §73.99, not §73.187. §73.187 is 'Limitations on daytime radiation' and addresses secondary skywave coverage — distinct from PSRA/PSSA permits. Replace the §73.187 cite in submission_checklist entry 6 with §73.99.
tests_required: test/exports/lmsFiling/form301am.test.js — assert checklist entries that mention 'PSRA' or 'PSSA' cite §73.99
findings.reproducibility_notes: genoa/src/exports/lmsFiling/form301am.js submission_checklist entry 6 (line ~623): '§73.187 pre-sunrise / post-sunset operation tables included if PSRA/PSSA requested'.

findings.title: Regulatory-context classifier omits AM nighttime warnings from current-rule failure set
findings.recommended_fix: PROTECTION_WARNING_CODES (line ~35) only lists FM_CONTOUR_PROTECTION_VIOLATION and FM_MINIMUM_SEPARATION_VIOLATION. Add AM_NIGHTTIME_PROTECTION_VIOLATION (from warnings.js) so an AM exhibit failing §73.182(k) NIF / §73.187 skywave protection is classified as 'fails_current_rules' and triggers the licensed_with_legacy_conflicts framing for an existing AM licensee. As written, AM nighttime allocation failures are silently classified 'not_evaluated' or 'passes_current_rules' in the regulatory-context block.
tests_required: test/engine/regulatory/context.test.js — synthesize an exhibit with AM_NIGHTTIME_PROTECTION_VIOLATION warning + LIC status and assert currentRuleCompliance === 'fails_current_rules'
findings.reproducibility_notes: genoa/src/engine/regulatory/context.js lines 35-38 (PROTECTION_WARNING_CODES Set) and lines 112-123 (classification logic).

findings.title: Service vocabulary points LPFM propagation/coverage cites at §73.811 (power/height rule)
findings.recommended_fix: In the LPFM vocab block (lines 58-72), propagation_cite and coverage_rule_cite are both set to '§73.811'. §73.811 governs LPFM ERP ceiling and presumptive HAAT; the propagation curves used for the LPFM 60 dBµV/m service contour come from §73.313 (HAAT method) and §73.333 (F(50,50) curves) applied with the LPFM parameter caps. Use propagation_cite='§73.333' so narratives citing '${vocab.propagation_cite}' read accurately for LPFM exhibits.
findings.reproducibility_notes: genoa/src/engine/finding/serviceWording.js LPFM block (lines 58-72). Any narrative or finding template that interpolates `${vocab.propagation_cite}` currently emits '§73.811' for LPFM exhibits.

findings.title: Executive Summary headline can read 'meets the regulatory bar' on tier-3 fallback runs
findings.recommended_fix: The legacyStatus === 'VERIFIED' branch (line ~94) renders 'is computationally verified and meets the regulatory bar' as the para3 plain-English verdict. The tier-3 / code-identity qualifier only appears in para4 recommendations. When exhibit.validation.fcc_curve_parity.fallback_tier > 1, qualify para3 to read 'is computationally verified against the engine reference (FCC live cross-check not exercised)' so the bolded verdict cannot be quoted standalone as a regulatory finding. §73.311 limits what predicted contours may be used for — the EXEC summary must not overstate the verification level.
tests_required: test/exports/engineeringReport/executiveSummary.test.js — para3 must not contain 'meets the regulatory bar' when fallback_tier > 1

findings.title: Form 301-AM principal-community label suggests a class distinction that does not exist
findings.recommended_fix: principal-community-contour-mv-m (line ~358) carries lms_label 'Principal community (city-grade) contour — 5 mV/m groundwave (AM-Class A) / 5 mV/m (B/C/D)'. Per §73.24(i) the 5 mV/m groundwave principal-community contour applies uniformly to ALL AM classes; the parenthetical implies a class-dependent value that is not in the rule. Replace with 'Principal community (city-grade) contour — 5 mV/m groundwave (all AM classes, §73.24(i))'.

findings.title: LPFM_RULE_VIOLATION warning cites only §73.811 while describing §73.807 violations
findings.recommended_fix: LPFM_RULE_VIOLATION (lines 139-141) titles the rule as '47 CFR §73.811' but the description references both 'ERP ceiling' and 'service-contour distance'. Service-contour-distance violations against full-service / NCE / translator stations are enforced under §73.807; ERP/HAAT ceilings are under §73.811. Update title to cite both §73.807 and §73.811.
